1.consolidated_definition: Que se enrolla. Tipo de funcionamiento de determinados equipos que se cierran enrollándose sobre sí mismos. Anglicismo crudo, poco frecuente. Tremendo apartamento en el piso 7. Con vista al playa y a la ciudad de San Juan. Pisos de marmol,remodelado con afacias, el bano del pasillo remodelado ultra moderno. A/C central, con cortinas roll over y de telas, tormenteras, calentador de linea, lamparas modernas (ClasificadosOnline, consultado 15-10-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Self-winding mechanism. Type of operation found in certain equipment that closes by winding itself around its own axis. Rare and informal anglicism.

Tremendous apartment on the 7th floor with a view of the beach and the city of San Juan. Marble floors, renovated with amenities, the hallway bathroom remodeled ultra modernly. Central air conditioning, with roll-over curtains and fabrics, storm shutters, line heater, modern lamps (ClasificadosOnline, consulted 15-10-08)
